caption: The drawing depicts a large, old-fashioned key oriented horizontally with the bow on the left and the bit on the right. The key is rendered in shades of gray and appears to be made of metal, as indicated by its texture and color. The bow of the key is oval in shape with a slightly thick contour, while the shaft is cylindrical and elongated, featuring a pair of rounded notches near the center. The bit is rectangular and branched, with multiple notches and steps, giving it a classic, antique appearance. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or patterns, providing contrast and centering attention on the key. There is some very small, faint writing in the lower right corner.
title: Shop Sign Key
